translations.web: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out, and serve me in this place.’
translations.bsb: ‘But I will punish the nation that enslaves them,’ God said, ‘and afterward they will come forth and worship Me in this place.’
translations.kjv: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
translations.asv: And the nation to which they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
